name: window-screenshot
title_zh: 截屏前先替你找准窗口再按快门
tagline_zh: 不用再手动切窗口、拖选区。它先定位目标窗口边界、置前，再精确截取，存图后自动校验。
tagline_en: No more manual window switching or region dragging. It locates, fronts, captures exact bounds, and verifies the.
desc_en: Use whenever the user needs a screenshot on Windows, including full-screen, region, app/window, report evidence, UI QA, debugging, or program-running screenshots. For target app/window screenshots, first identify the window position and size, bring the target window to the front, capture exactly the window bounds, and verify the saved image.
why_zh: 机制上先解析窗口几何信息再触发捕获，避免因窗口未激活或尺寸漂移导致的截错、截偏；存图后校验文件存在。
why_en: Resolves window geometry before capture, preventing off-target shots from inactive or resized windows; verifies file after.
limit_zh: 仅支持 Windows 原生窗口，不覆盖 UWP 或 DirectX 全屏游戏；截取区域需为可见桌面。
limit_en: Windows native windows only; no UWP or DirectX fullscreen games. Requires visible desktop; minimized windows can't be captured. Depends on.
title_en: Window screenshot that finds and fronts the target first
